name: hacocoon-agent-workspaces
description: Create isolated Hacocoon worktrees and Environments for VS Code coding-agent sessions.

languageModelTools.name: hacocoon_createAgentWorkspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new linked Git worktree and isolated Hacocoon Environment for an independently writable coding-agent task. Use this when another agent needs its own OS/runtime-isolated workspace. This provisions the workspace only; it does not copy model-provider credentials or start a native VS Code Agent Host session.

branch.description: New Git branch name for the isolated agent workspace.

open.description: Open the resulting Hacocoon Remote-SSH workspace in a new VS Code window. Defaults to false for batch orchestration.

languageModelTools.name: hacocoon_listAgentWorkspaces
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List Hacocoon agent workspaces created by this VS Code extension. Returns safe orchestration metadata only and omits internal session identities and credentials.

languageModelTools.name: hacocoon_releaseAgentWorkspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Release one VS Code-owned Hacocoon agent workspace by exact Git branch name. The Environment is released first; dirty worktrees are preserved and Git branches are never deleted automatically.

branch.description: Exact Git branch name of the VS Code-owned Hacocoon agent workspace to release.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.gitExecutable.description: Git executable inside the Hacocoon execution host. Commands are executed without a shell.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.adapterExecutabl.description: haco-agent-host executable inside the Hacocoon execution host.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.worktreeRoot.description: Absolute Linux root for VS Code-created linked worktrees. Empty uses a .hacocoon-worktrees directory beside the repository.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.wslDistro.description: WSL distribution used from Windows to run Git and haco-agent-host.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.repositoryPath.description: Optional absolute Linux repository path inside the configured WSL distribution. If empty, a matching Remote-WSL workspace path is reused or VS Code prompts for a path.
